issues.display_title: Issue #4066: Handle Invalid Street View Account on Publish Page
issues.main_description_html:
Acceptance Criteria

AC-1: Validity check on page load

  • When the publish page mounts and a Street View account is resolved (default or from publish_account), GET /users/check-google-account?email=<email> is called once
  • The check fires again whenever the user manually changes the selected account
  • No auto-popup modal is shown on page load regardless of validity result

AC-2: Publish button — checking state

  • While checkGoogleAccount is in-flight (accountValidity.checking === true) or before it starts (accountValidity === null), the Publish button shows the existing "Validating..." state (disabled, same as when isButtonStateReady is false)

AC-3: Alert — TOKEN_INVALID

  • When the selected account returns valid: false, reason: "TOKEN_INVALID", the yellow info box in PublishAlert contains a list item: "Your selected Street View account cannot publish — access token expired. [Reconnect at Street View Accounts.]" where the bracketed text is a link to /profile/street-view

AC-4: Alert — MISSING_SCOPE

  • Same as AC-3 but with "missing permissions" text

AC-5: Alert — valid account

  • When the account is valid, no extra list item is added to the yellow info box

AC-6: Alert — API error (fail-safe)

  • If checkGoogleAccount returns an error, no extra list item is shown; the account is treated as valid

AC-7: Expired chip in account trigger

  • When the selected account is invalid (TOKEN_INVALID or MISSING_SCOPE), a NextUI Chip color="danger" variant="flat" size="sm" with label "Expired" appears to the right of the account name/email in the closed dropdown trigger

AC-8: Chip — valid account

  • No chip shown when the selected account is valid

AC-9: Publish button — invalid account

  • Pressing the Publish button while the selected account is invalid opens the StreetViewExpired modal
  • The modal body shows the existing description AND a reason line: "Reason: Access token expired" (TOKEN_INVALID) or "Reason: Missing permissions" (MISSING_SCOPE)

AC-10: Publish button — valid account

  • Pressing the Publish button while the selected account is valid proceeds to the existing BeforePublishModal flow unchanged

AC-11: No double API call

  • StreetViewExpired does not fire its own checkGoogleAccount call when precomputedValidity is provided by PublishButton

AC-12: Other callers of StreetViewExpired unaffected

  • When precomputedValidity is not passed, StreetViewExpired behaves identically to the current implementation

AC-13: Locale — English

  • All new i18n keys exist in en.json with correct English values

AC-14: Locale — other languages

  • All non-English locale files contain the new keys with English text as placeholder
  • No existing keys are removed or modified

issues.display_title: Issue #4065: Implement Disconnected Street View Account Status
issues.main_description_html:
Brainstorming File:
2026-06-04-street-view-expired-status-design.md

Acceptance Criteria

AC-1: Status check triggered on page load

  • After the accounts list is fetched and rendered, GET /users/check-google-account?email=<email> is called once per account
  • All calls fire in parallel — one failing call does not block the others
  • The check runs on every full page load (mount), not on subsequent re-renders

AC-2: Checking state

  • While a status check is in-flight for an account, a small spinner (NextUI Spinner, size="sm") appears in the row between the name/email block and the action buttons
  • No "Expired" chip and no "Reconnect" button are shown during the checking state
  • The copy and delete buttons remain visible and functional during the checking state

AC-3: Expired badge

  • When the API returns valid: false for an account, a NextUI Chip with color="danger", variant="flat", size="sm" and label "Expired" appears in the row
  • The chip is positioned appears to the right of the name and email
  • The chip is not shown for accounts where valid: true
  • The chip is not shown for accounts whose check API call failed

AC-4: Expired badge — tooltip

  • Hovering the "Expired" chip displays a NextUI Tooltip with a reason string:
    • reason: "TOKEN_INVALID" → tooltip reads "Access token expired"
    • reason: "MISSING_SCOPE" → tooltip reads "Missing permissions"

AC-5: Reconnect button

  • When an account is expired (valid: false), a NextUI Button with size="sm", color="warning" and label "Reconnect" appears to the left of the copy button
  • The reconnect button is not shown for valid accounts or accounts in the checking state
  • The copy and delete buttons remain present alongside the reconnect button

AC-6: Reconnect action

  • Pressing the "Reconnect" button calls getGoogleStreetViewToken('/profile/street-view')
  • This initiates the same Google OAuth redirect flow as the "Add Street View Account" button
  • No modal is opened; the action is immediate

AC-7: Valid account — no change

  • For an account that returns valid: true, the row looks identical to the current implementation — no chip, no reconnect button, no spinner after the check completes
  • Existing radio, avatar, name, email, copy, and delete elements are unaffected

AC-8: API error — fail safe

  • If the /users/check-google-account call fails for an account (network error or non-2xx response), no badge and no reconnect button are shown for that account
  • The spinner disappears and the row returns to its current default appearance
  • The account is never falsely marked as expired due to a check failure

AC-9: Locale — English

  • t_street_view_account.t_status_expired exists in en.json with value "Expired"
  • t_street_view_account.t_status_reason_token_invalid exists in en.json with value "Access token expired"
  • t_street_view_account.t_status_reason_missing_scope exists in en.json with value "Missing permissions"
  • t_street_view_account.t_status_reason_unknown exists in en.json with value "Account needs reconnecting"
  • The "Reconnect" button label uses the existing key t_street_view_expired.t_reconnect — no new key is added for it

AC-10: Locale — other languages

  • All non-English locale files contain the 4 new keys above under t_street_view_account with the English text as a placeholder
  • No existing keys in any locale file are removed or modified

issues.display_title: Issue #4067: Implement 3D Map Fitler Toggle Button at GoThru Dashboard Map
issues.main_description_html:
Brainstorming File:
2026-06-08-map-3d-toggle-design.md

Context

When users open a tour in the dashboard, they see a map showing where all their panorama photos are located. Right now, that map always loads in 3D mode — it shows the world at an angle, with depth and tilt. While this looks visually impressive, it can make it harder to quickly understand where panoramas are placed, especially for users who just want a clear, top-down view of their tour layout.

There is currently no way for users to switch between the 3D view and a simpler flat map. They are stuck with whichever view the app decides to show them.

Goal

Give users a simple button inside the map that lets them switch between a flat 2D view (top-down, easy to read) and an angled 3D view (tilted, gives a sense of depth). The flat 2D view becomes the new default since it's clearer for most users. The button is small, unobtrusive, and sits in the top-right corner of the map — always within reach without cluttering the interface.

This applies to all three map views inside a tour: the main view map, the walking tour map, and the slideshow map.

Acceptance Criteria

  • When a user opens any tour map, it loads in flat 2D view by default (not 3D)
  • There is a small button in the top-right corner of each tour map (View, Walking, Slideshow)
  • Clicking the button smoothly switches from 2D to 3D — the map tilts into place with a short animation
  • Clicking the button again switches back to 2D — the map flattens out
  • The button icon changes to reflect what will happen when clicked:
    • In 2D mode → shows a cube icon (meaning: "click to see in 3D")
    • In 3D mode → shows a map icon (meaning: "click to go back to flat")
  • Hovering over the button shows a short label: "3D View" or "2D View"
  • Each map works independently — switching to 3D on the walking map does not change the view map
  • The existing map controls (zoom in/out, locate me, fullscreen) remain accessible — they move to the bottom-right corner to make room for the toggle
  • The toggle works correctly on all three maps: View, Walking, and Slideshow

issues.display_title: Issue #4073: Blur Section UI Refinements & AI Feature Cleanup
issues.main_description_html:
Description

Alongside the backend fixes for the blur processing, several UI updates are required on the Blur section interface (Anonymize 360 Images) to improve usability and remove non-functional features.

Sub-tasks

  • Relocate Button: Move the "Manual Blur" button to the right side of the action bar (align it next to the "Preview Tour" and "Apply AI Blur" buttons).
  • Remove AI License Plate Blurring: Completely remove the "AI License plate blurring" option/toggle from the AI section. The feature is currently underperforming and non-functional.

Acceptance Criteria

  1. The "Manual Blur" button is correctly positioned on the right (next to "Preview Tour" and "Apply AI Blur").
  2. Images with existing manual blur entries in the 8_blooring table display a distinct blue icon on their UI cards.
  3. The AI License plate blurring option is no longer visible to users anywhere in the UI.

Reference (annotated screenshot)

  • "Manual Blur" button → move it to the right, next to "Preview Tour" and "Apply AI Blur".
  • Image thumbnails → if an image has manual blur in the 8_blooring table, add the (blue) icon from the button onto the image card.

Reference: docs/superpowers/specs/analyze-all.md — see §2.3 / §4 (Tour editor: face/plate blurring).
